captions.detailed: A panoramic sunroof cassette assembly consisting of a black rectangular outer frame housing two main glass panels. The front panel features a dark-tinted glass surface with a raised spoiler-like wind deflector pattern, designed to tilt on a revolute hinge. The rear panel is a wide, flat glass sheet configured to slide horizontally along two parallel silver guide rails via a prismatic joint.
captions.instruction: Generate a panoramic sunroof cassette assembly. It must feature a dark rectangular outer frame with silver guide rails, a front wind-deflector section configured on a revolute hinge, and a large rear sliding glass panel operating on prismatic rails.
captions.factory: Construct the main frame by creating a large rectangular flat base and cutting out a central opening. Model the parallel guide rails as long, thin cylinders or rectangular bars along the inner edges. Create the front tilt panel and rear sliding panel using thin rectangular boxes, adding a textured pattern to the front panel, and define their relative motion using revolute and prismatic joints respectively.
